name: schema-loss-audit-taxonomy-map-processing-flow-admin-cleanup
note: Phase 0-D is read-only against every FROZEN artifact and every Phase-0-C-owned reconciliation/canonical file. Phase 0-D ships four WPs (WP-ADMIN-CLEANUP-01, WP-TAXONOMY-MAP-01, WP-PROCESSING-FLOW-MAP-01, WP-SCHEMA-LOSS-AUDIT-01) that render existing sources of truth and detect loss; no phase-0-D work may edit the sources themselves. Reviewer decisions from WP-SCHEMA-LOSS-AUDIT-01 re-open upstream freeze gates per Section 2.7 but never write to a FROZEN file directly. The Taxonomy and Processing-Flow markdown files are in the allowed list only because the map pages need to render them and may commit rendered-svg companions; edits to their prose remain reviewer-authored through the Freeze Gate PR mechanism (Codex may not mutate them mid-phase). scripts/schema-loss/** is allowed because WP-SCHEMA-LOSS-AUDIT-01 ships the residual and integrity audit scripts. pages/ingest.js is allowed as an explicit single-file deletion path for WP-ADMIN-CLEANUP-01 step 3; pages/review/[id].js, pages/review/index.js, and components/DealsTable.js are allowed only to remove their legacy /ingest CTAs so the page deletion can land. No other pages/** modifications are permitted. archive/strings-reviewer/** is allowed because PR #141's preserved reviewer UI folds into Phase 0-D scope (see WP-ADMIN-CLEANUP-01). Freeze-gate exception (added 2026-07-07): `docs/schema-shape/phase-0-C.frozen`, `docs/schema-shape/audit-state.json`, and `pages/api/admin/audit/freeze.js` are permitted in Phase 0-D because closing G-0C is a Phase-0-D-owned action (the gate blocks all four 0-D WPs). Editing any other frozen shape file remains forbidden. The freeze endpoint is on the allowed list to permit an async refactor required for section-anchor hydration; its logic must not change beyond that refactor.
